title: Construct structural models
action: Construct initial atomic structures for bulk β-Ga2O3 (C2/m symmetry) and hydrogen-passivated monolayer, bilayer, and trilayer Ga2O3 slabs by slicing the bulk along the (100) surface and adding vacuum.
description: Model building: generate the four systems that will undergo geometry optimization.

title: DFT geometry optimization
action: For each system (bulk, monolayer, bilayer, trilayer), perform DFT geometry optimization to relax atomic positions and cell parameters. Choose appropriate exchange‑correlation functional and pseudopotentials, and converge forces and total energy to suitable thresholds.
description: Relax atomic coordinates and cell dimensions; necessary for accurate elastic constants.

title: Compute elastic constants
action: Calculate the complete elastic constant matrix for each optimized structure using DFT. Output all 13 independent elastic constants for bulk (in GPa) and for each slab (in N/m).
description: Elastic tensor for bulk and three 2D thicknesses. This is the primary raw output from the DFT step.
output_schema: Array of objects. Each object contains keys: system (one of 'bulk', 'monolayer', 'bilayer', 'trilayer'), C11, C22, C33, C44, C55, C66, C12, C13, C15, C23, C25, C35, C46 (all numeric).

title: Derive elastic moduli and anisotropy
action: From the elastic constants, use averaging methods to compute for each system: bulk modulus, shear modulus, Young's modulus, Poisson's ratio, and anisotropy indices.
description: Polycrystalline elastic moduli and anisotropy descriptors derived from the Cij matrix.
output_schema: Array of objects. Each object contains keys: system ('bulk', 'monolayer', 'bilayer', 'trilayer'), bulk_modulus (float, GPa for bulk, N/m for slabs), shear_modulus (float, same units), Youngs_modulus (float, same units), Poisson_ratio (float, dimensionless), anisotropy_index_B (float, dimensionless), anisotropy_index_G (float, dimensionless).

title: Compute thermal properties
action: Using the derived moduli, structural parameters, and analytical formulas from the literature, compute the longitudinal, transverse, and average sound velocities, the Debye temperature, the minimum thermal conductivity, and the saturated high-temperature specific heat capacity for each system.
description: Thermodynamic quantities: sound velocities, Debye temperature, minimum thermal conductivity, and saturated heat capacity.
output_schema: Array of objects. Each object contains keys: system ('bulk', 'monolayer', 'bilayer', 'trilayer'), k_min (float, W cm⁻¹ K⁻¹), Theta_D (float, K), v_m (float, m s⁻¹), v_l (float, m s⁻¹), v_t (float, m s⁻¹), saturated_C_V (float, J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹).
